SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 1, Special Branch.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. S. R. D. 66/40 Date March 9 19 40.）

Subject. A. Shornik, applicant for enrolment in the Jewish Company, S.V.C.

Made by. D.S. Pavloff ........................................ Forwarded by. D. I. Crawford

（批：Copy sent to Staff Office LWC）

Alexander Borisovitch SHORNIK, Russian
Jew, was born on October 15, 1920 in Harbin,
Manchuria. According to his own statement,
he left Harbin for Tientsin together with his
parents in 1922 and resided in that city until
November 1939 when he came to Shanghai. His
father, who was a Soviet citizen, left China for
the U.S.S.R. in 1936 and is still residing in
that country.

Whilst in Tientsin, the applicant also
became a Soviet citizen, but at present intends
to apply for emigrant papers. Upon his arrival
in Shanghai on November 6, 1939, he worked for
his brother, V. Shornik, who is a partner in the
business known as General Transportation Company,
128/531 Museum Road.

On February 13, 1940 he secured a position
as a salesman with the Mercury Press.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police
records detrimental to his character.

（印：FILED BY S.B. REGISTRY DATE 11/3/40）

I. G. Pavloff.
D. S.

报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特科登记处 编号 S. R. D. 66/40 日期 1940年3月9日。）

事由：A. Shornik，申请加入上海义勇队（S.V.C.）犹太连。

呈报人：D.S. Pavloff ____ 转呈人：D. I. Crawford

（批：副本已送职员办公室 LWC）

亚历山大·鲍里索维奇·肖尔尼克（Alexander Borisovitch SHORNIK），俄罗斯犹太人，1920年10月15日出生于满洲哈尔滨。据其自述，他于1922年随父母离开哈尔滨前往天津，并居住在该市直至1939年11月来到上海。其父为苏联公民，已于1936年离开中国前往苏联，目前仍居住在该国。

在天津期间，申请人亦成为苏联公民，但目前打算申请移民证件。他于1939年11月6日抵达上海后，为其兄 V. Shornik 工作，其兄是位于博物馆路128/531号、商号为“通用运输公司”（General Transportation Company）的合伙人。

1940年2月13日，他在墨丘利印刷所（Mercury Press）谋得一份销售员职位。

工部局警务处档案中并无不利于其品行的记录。

（印：由特科登记处归档 日期 1940年3月11日）

I. G. Pavloff.
D. S.
